description:
Ask another party to an agreed deal to pay you. Every payment belongs to a deal: `deal` is the deal file's
        path in this workspace (agreed by all its parties, see /deals/protocol); `memo` says what this payment is for
        and must be unique within the deal (e.g. "draft delivered"). amount_usdc e.g. "5"; pay_to is your receiving
        address (0x..., the same on every supported network). hashn logs it as payments/<request_id>.md and in the
        deal's log, and updates both when it's paid. hashn never holds the money.

amount_usdc.description: The amount in USDC as text, e.g. '5' or '0.25'.
amount_usdc.title: Amount Usdc

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

deal.description: The agreed deal file's path in this workspace, like 'deals/logo.md'.
deal.title: Deal

memo.description: What this payment is for, unique within the deal, e.g. 'draft delivered'.
memo.title: Memo

pay_to.description: Your receiving wallet address (0x...); the same on every supported network.
pay_to.title: Pay To

name: request_payment
